rationale: Both describe an increase in fat mass.
Both concern PPAR, but stressor binding does not by itself establish activation.

Both describe disrupted PPAR signaling, but one is transcriptional dysregulation of the network and the other is disrupted nuclear isoform signaling, so curators should check whether they are equivalent.
Both concern aromatase activity, in opposite directions (inhibition vs induction).
Both describe increased estradiol, but one specifies plasma and the other is general availability.
Both target the ryanodine receptor, but generic activation and RyR2 hyperphosphorylation are distinct processes.
Both involve laminin binding, but one is general ECM laminin binding and the other is disrupted laminin-integrin receptor binding.
Both describe impaired oligodendrocyte lineage progression, but differentiation and maturation may not be equivalent.
